verdict.rationale: The official Vue site links to "Get Security Updates for Vue 2" alongside a "Migration from Vue 2" guide. That shows a documented path to keep getting security fixes for the older major version while planning a migration. The evidence is only a link title, with no details on who provides the updates, their scope, duration or cost. Missing for 10: documented details of the extended-support offering (provider, duration, terms), confirmation it is first-party rather than an external arrangement, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the updates are actually delivered.
